statement: Let the parent action vary only MTS primitives: motion/time/space coframes or routing fields, transport/connection data, matter fields, and boundary/domain variables.
payoff: Z/R_AB is not automatically a primitive just because it is definable from readout variables.
blocker: the full primitive list is not sourced from one parent action

statement: R_AB=ln(T^2 S)=2 ln(J_q) is a derived compatibility/readout scalar; treating it as an independent field is an extra dynamical choice.
payoff: this supports the category route: derived compatibility data should not get its own local scalar energy by default.
blocker: definition alone does not forbid all primitive invariants from projecting onto R_AB

statement: Allowed local operators are built from primitives and their covariant/exterior derivatives; raw Z/R_AB may enter only as quotient/compatibility data, constraint target, exact boundary class, or post-variation readout.
payoff: forbids standalone K_Z(dZ)^2, M_Z^2 Z^2, J_Z Z, and B_Z boundary flux in the exact-removal branch.
blocker: operator grammar is proposed, not derived from MTS primitives

statement: If primitive derivatives induce derivatives of R_AB by algebraic substitution, that is not a standalone Z kinetic term unless a new independent coefficient survives after rewriting the primitive action.
payoff: prevents both overclaiming and over-penalizing: primitive geometry can vary while raw representative Z is still nonphysical.
blocker: requires a parent action rewrite to identify whether an independent coefficient survives

statement: A Lambda_Z C_Z block is admissible only if Lambda_Z and C_Z arise from parent compatibility/Dirac preservation, not as a magic multiplier inserted to force GR.
payoff: keeps the clean exact route without permitting closure-only axioms.
blocker: auxiliary origin and Dirac/boundary checks remain missing

statement: Matter, source normalization, clocks, EM, and boundary maps must descend through quotient-owned observed variables; any direct Z source slot moves the branch to finite residuals.
payoff: blocks WEP, clock, R10, and source-weight leaks.
blocker: matter/readout descent and boundary no-charge are not parent-signed

statement: If CAT2031_0 through CAT2031_5 are parent-signed, raw Z/R_AB is compatibility/constraint/readout data rather than a propagating local scalar; local Z fifth-force terms are illegal in the exact branch.
payoff: this would derive local Z-removal without tuning K0,V0,mZ2 or hiding scalar hair.

statement: The category principle is mathematically coherent and now precisely stated, but current evidence does not prove it from MTS primitives. The branch remains nonclaim; if the principle fails, finite Z coefficients must be acquired.
payoff: we have a real decision point instead of a vague gap.
